subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and cancel/steer/resume supervision extend the metadata-only audit/task/artifact foundations, or use a dedicated subagent lifecycle ledger/API?
rationale: The choice fixes the persisted data shape, public operator semantics, redaction policy, retention model, authorization boundary, and whether OpenClaw has one or multiple lifecycle sources of truth.

options.title: Extend audit/task/artifact foundations
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, and artifact lookup surfaces.

options.title: Create a subagent ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle and supervision table/API while accepting the maintenance cost of another durable source of truth.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Decline the durable receipt/control contract for now and keep audit.list, task summaries, artifacts, and subagent list output as separate operator tools.

recommendation.title: Extend audit/task/artifact foundations
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, and artifact lookup surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current audit foundation and has the strongest recent connection to the persistence, redaction, and public operator surfaces involved.
